fields.name: CulledAtFrame
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x18B3070 (4-byte frame storage) writes 0; its only caller bg3.exe+0x18B2B00 (system update with signature (system, world, GameTime const&), called from bg3.exe+0x7564C0) stores *(int*)(GameTime + 0x10) for every entity it culls. GameTime+0x10 is a 32-bit counter (SE calls it 'double Unknown'); live 0x305B / 0x306F (12379 / 12399) fit a frame/tick count, so the component records when the entity was culled.

open_questions: What GameTime+0x10 counts exactly (SE ExposedTypes.h names it 'Unknown' and types it double; the game reads 4 bytes as int).
